title: SendGrid keys after emoji and CJK text, and on CRLF lines
summary: The SendGrid key shape after emoji and Chinese text on the same line, and on a CRLF-terminated line under a comment.
rationale: Ranges are byte offsets, so multibyte text before the key moves the offsets; a carriage return after the key must not be counted into it.

expectation.rationale: Flagged. Byte-exact range of the key, regardless of the text before it or the line ending after it.
